objective.text: Disable production debug rendering so exception details are not exposed to unauthenticated clients.

difficulty.rationale: Verify that the public error representation does not expose internal diagnostic details.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: An unauthenticated production request fails with an exception containing an internal filesystem path. Which configuration and response check address accidental diagnostic exposure?

options.text: Clear route cache after every exception while leaving debug enabled.
options.rationale: Route cache state is not the debug-detail exposure control.
options.misconception: Route cache state is not the debug-detail exposure control.

options.text: Use debug=true and hide the browser console panel.
options.rationale: Browser tooling visibility does not remove diagnostic data already sent in the response.
options.misconception: Browser tooling visibility does not remove diagnostic data already sent in the response.

options.text: Use debug=false and verify the public error response omits the internal message and trace.
options.rationale: Production debug rendering can expose details; the regression should verify the actual public response as well as the configuration.

options.text: Keep debug=true but change only the logging channel’s level.
options.rationale: Log filtering does not control the detailed HTTP error representation.
options.misconception: Log filtering does not control the detailed HTTP error representation.
